newsitem.title: BRAZIL: BRAZIL PARANAGUA/SANTOS SUGAR SHIPPING CONDITIONS.
newsitem.headline: BRAZIL PARANAGUA/SANTOS SUGAR SHIPPING CONDITIONS.

text.p: The Brazilian ports of Paranagua and Santos
reported the following conditions for shipping sugar.
PARANAGUA:
Vessels: Catherine H loading 14,000 tonnes bagged sugar. Anteos loading
14,000 tonnes bagged sugar. Lady Olga loading 8,069 tonnes bagged sugar.
Waiting to dock, five vessels to load bagged sugar and three to load bulk.
Road: 267 trucks carrying sugar arrived on Aug 12.
Loading: no figures available.
Stocks: no figures available.
SANTOS:
Vessels: Global Star, Libanus and Thapton each loading 14,000 tonnes bagged
sugar. Tia Angelica loading 12,250 tonnes bagged sugar. Valentin Khutorsk
loading 12,500 tonnes bagged sugar. Maro to load 13,000 tonnes bagged sugar.
Fontana loading 14,000 tonnes bulk sugar. Waiting to dock, one vessel to load
bulk sugar and seven to load sugar (unspecified). No vessels docked at
Cargill private terminal. Waiting to dock, two vessels to load bulk sugar and
one to load sugar (unspecified).
Loading (Aug 12): 5,301 tonnes bagged sugar, 7,074 tonnes bulk.
Stocks: 32,792 tonnes bulk in CODESP warehouses, no bagged sugar. Private warehouses already with bagged sugar but stock levels unavailable.
((--Joelle Diderich, Sao Paulo newsroom +55 11 248 5417))
